title: Accessible name (read by screen readers) of the Settings nav, the list of settings pages beside each settings page.
groups.workspace.title: Heading of the first group in the Settings nav: settings for the whole workspace (team), as opposed to the person's own account.
groups.workspace.description: Line under the heading of every settings page in the Workspace group (settings for the whole team). "socios" are the product's AI agents.
groups.account.title: Heading of the second group in the Settings nav: the signed-in person's own settings. Other screens refer to it as "Account → …".
groups.account.description: Line under the heading of every settings page in the Account group (the person's own settings). $t(common:product) becomes the product name, Socio (keep it as is); "socios" are the AI agents.
sections.workspace: Settings nav entry for the workspace's general settings page.
sections.people: Settings nav entry for the admins' page listing the workspace's people, their roles and groups. Admins only.
sections.access: Settings nav entry for the admins' page about how people sign in to this server (sign-in methods and allowed emails). Admins only.
sections.secrets: Settings nav entry for the admins' page of the workspace's secrets (passwords and keys socios may use). Admins only.
sections.data-api: Settings nav entry for the admins' page of data API tokens, used by scripts to fill the company's datasets. Admins only.
sections.chat-skills: Settings nav entry for the admins' page of chat skills: saved instructions people start a message with, such as /standup. Admins only.
sections.account: Settings nav entry for the person's own profile page (name, sign-in, devices).
sections.operator: Settings nav entry for the server operator's page (backends, storage, health). Admins only.
sections.socio-access: "Socio" is the product name; socios are the AI agents. This page lists which socios may act on the person's behalf.
sections.deleted-spaces: "Space" is a product noun (a shared area for a team's pages and chats); keep it capitalized if your language capitalizes nouns that way.
sections.features: Settings nav entry for the admins' page of released features the workspace may switch off. Admins only.
sections.early-access: Settings nav entry for the admins' page of experimental features to try before release. Admins only.
sections.features-dev: Settings nav entry for the admins' page of unfinished features, shown only on internal deployments. Admins only.
sections.coding: Settings nav entry for the admins' page about coding sessions (socios running code). Admins only.
sections.notifications: Settings nav entry for the person's page choosing how socios (AI agents) notify them (push, Telegram).
sections.inference: Settings nav entry for the person's page about which AI model their chats run on and the AI subscriptions they connect.
sections.archived-chats: Settings nav entry for the person's page listing the chats they archived (hidden from the sidebar, not deleted).
sections.connected-agents: Settings nav entry for the person's page listing outside AI agents (such as Claude Code) that act in Socio for them.
sections.telegram: Settings nav entry for the person's page linking their Telegram account. Telegram is a brand name; don't translate it.
sections.performance: Settings nav entry for the person's page that records how fast the app responds, for a bug report.
version: Footer under every settings page: the product name and its version number, such as "Socio v0.56.0".
versionCommit: The build's git commit, shown after the version in parentheses. Keep the parentheses unless your language marks asides differently.
releaseNotes: Link in the footer under every settings page, after the version number; opens the list of release notes.
needsSignIn: "Better Auth" is the name of the sign-in library; don't translate it. "The local picker" is the development sign-in that lists test users.
save.saving: Status at the top right of a settings card while a change saves on its own (there is no Save button).
save.saved: Status at the top right of a settings card once a change has saved.
save.failed: Error on a settings card or in a workspace dialog when a change couldn't be saved; it asks the person to read the workspace's error message and try again.
save.undo: Button in the toast after a setting saved; it puts the previous value back.
save.undone: Toast after Undo put a setting's previous value back.
paused.title: Title of the home page widget about the AI agents (socios) as a whole.
paused.paused: Status on the home page's Socios widget: every socio (AI agent) is paused by an admin.
paused.active: Status on the home page's Socios widget: every socio (AI agent) is working normally.
paused.resume: Button: lets every socio (AI agent) work again.
paused.pause: Button: stops every socio (AI agent) until resumed.
paused.waiting: Line on the home page's Socios widget while every socio (AI agent) is paused: scheduled tasks don't run until an admin resumes them.
paused.scheduled: How many scheduled tasks are waiting to run.
crumbs.person: Breadcrumb for one person's page under Settings › People.
providers.google-native: A sign-in method on People and Devices: a Google account linked in the Socio mobile app (not on the web). "(app)" means the mobile app.
providers.apple-native: A sign-in method on People and Devices: an Apple account linked in the Socio mobile app (Sign in with Apple). "(app)" means the mobile app.
